The '''A99 aquata breather''', or '''aqua breather''', also called a '''Jedi breathing device''', was a small breathing apparatus that allowed [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-breathing lifeforms to survive underwater, in space, or among noxious gas for up to two hours.<ref name="SWCVD" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] commonly carried aquata breathers during field operations.

==Description==
[[File:KenobiA99AquataBreather-TPM.png|thumb|left|180px|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] using an A99.]]
The A99 aquata breather was a breathing apparatus that allowed the user to breathe [[Water/Legends|underwater]] or in hazardous environments. Some considered the A99 aquata breather to be more reliable than standard [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]]. This was largely due to the device being made of a single part rather than several connected components.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

A99s were a standard part of survival packs such as [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belts]] and [[field kit]]s. Small and lightweight, the breathers weighed 0.2 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and cost three hundred and fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="RPG-Core" />

The device utilized filtering mechanisms to separate external gaseous mixtures and relied on miniature tanks of compressed oxygen to provide breathable gas. The A99 model had a number of different variants customized for use by alien species; often supplying not oxygen but an equally important gas. The [[Antiox breath mask/Legends|antiox variant]], commonly used by [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] such as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], supplied not only [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] gases but also protected the wearer's face from the harsh effects of oxygen.

==History==
[[File:A99_breathers.png|thumb|right|150px|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] & [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] using A99s.]]
[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used aquata breathers when traveling to the underwater city of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

Obi-Wan would use the same A99 [[19 BBY/Legends|over a decade later]], after he and [[Boga/Legends|Boga]] fell into a sinkhole abyss on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], trying to escape [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] newly unleashed [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].

==Behind the scenes==
According to [[Hasbro]], Obi-Wan Kenobi kept an A99 aquata breather in a chest in [[Ben Kenobi's home/Legends|his hut]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], notwithstanding the lack of water on the desert planet.
